reporting: Syndrome by setting boxes (BSI: IPD and ICU; UTI, respiratory and SSTI: OPD, IPD and ICU). Each box prints the total isolates, the prevalence (% of the group) of the most common pathogens, one percent-susceptible list pooled over all Gram-positive cocci and one pooled over all Gram-negative bacteria (each with the group n), and a separate percent-susceptible list for Pseudomonas with its n. No per-drug tested numbers; AST method and breakpoint standard not stated.

verification.note: Values parsed from the PDF text layer (positional parse of the sensitivity column, bounded per box) and compared value by value with the rendered pages (PDF pages 14 to 25, scale 2.2); parse and images agree for all 101 recorded cells and all 12 row n values.

notes: Antibiogram section (printed pages 6 to 17, PDF pages 14 to 25) of the SKNMC and GH Antibiotic Policy for Hospital, Version 2.1, dated 15 December 2024 (implementation 1 January 2025). Only organism-level lists are recorded: the 11 'Pseudomonas (n=...)' lines, one per box, and the Respiratory-ICU Gram-positive list, which that box attributes entirely to Staphylococcus aureus (prevalence 100% of the Gram-positive cocci). The pooled Gram-positive and Gram-negative lists mix several organisms and are left out (see excluded), so this file does not give E. coli, Klebsiella, Acinetobacter or enterococcal figures even though the boxes name them. Syndromes are recorded as specimens: BSI as blood, UTI as urine, respiratory as respiratory, SSTI as pus. IPD is recorded as wards because each syndrome has a separate ICU box. There is no BSI-OPD box. The data period is printed only as 2024 without months; since the policy is dated 15 December 2024 it cannot include all of December 2024. The Pseudomonas n printed on each line does not match the Pseudomonas share given in the prevalence column (a percentage of the Gram-negative group), so it may count only tested or only P. aeruginosa isolates; recorded as printed. Pseudomonas lines print 'Pipracillin', recorded as piperacillin. Page numbers are PDF pages (printed page number plus 8).
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 101 cells and all 12 row n values re-read against the page images (PDF pages 15 to 25, scale 2.2 to 3), each value read before comparing; 0 transcription errors, nothing corrected.

excluded.what: Pooled 'Gram Positive Cocci (n=...)' percent-susceptible lists of 10 boxes (all except Respiratory-ICU)
excluded.why: pooled over all Gram-positive cocci of the box, a mix of S. aureus, CoNS, enterococci and streptococci in the printed proportions (Respiratory-OPD lists no pathogen at all); no organism-level figure is printed and there is no canonical key for a pooled Gram-positive group

excluded.what: Pooled 'Gram Negative Bacteria (n=...)' percent-susceptible lists of all 11 boxes
excluded.why: pooled over all Gram-negative bacteria of the box (Enterobacterales, Acinetobacter, Burkholderia, Stenotrophomonas, Salmonella and Pseudomonas together); not organism-specific and there is no canonical key for a pooled Gram-negative group

excluded.what: 'Most Common Pathogens' prevalence columns of all 11 boxes
excluded.why: printed as per cent of the Gram-positive or Gram-negative group, not as isolate numbers; turning them into counts would need computing, so no counts are recorded
